title: Where does it live?
description:
Print addresses from each area of memory and see how they group.

```
code    (a function)   0x55d2a3c01189
static  (a global)     0x55d2a3c04010
heap    (new int)      0x55d2a4e8e2b0
stack   (a local)      0x7ffc1a2b3c4c
```
hints: Put `(address, label)` pairs into a vector of `std::pair<std::uintptr_t, std::string>` and sort it.
requirements: Print the address of a function, a global, a `static` local, two heap blocks and two locals in different functions.
Write in a comment what you notice (stack near the top, heap and globals lower).
stretch: Run it twice and see the addresses change (address space layout randomisation).
